title: LLM Jargons Explained: Part 1 - Decoder Explained
description: An introduction to Transformer decoders, explaining masked self-attention, pre-filling, and the auto-regressive generation process in modern LLMs.

title: LLM Jargons Explained: Part 2 - Multi Query & Group Query Attention
description: An educational guide explaining the mechanics of Multi-Query Attention (MQA) and Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), highlighting how they improve memory bandwidth and speed up LLM inference.

title: LLM Jargons Explained: Part 3 - Sliding Window Attention Explained
description: An analysis of Sliding Window Attention (SWA) and how models like Mistral 7B use localized windows to handle long context sequences efficiently.

title: LLM Jargons Explained: Part 4 - KV Cache Explained
description: A detailed breakdown of Key-Value (KV) caching in transformer models, detailing how it optimizes sequence generation speed by saving key and value tensors.

title: LLM Jargons Explained: Part 5 - PagedAttention Explained
description: Learn how PagedAttention, the core technology behind vLLM, manages KV cache memory layout dynamically to reduce fragmentation and scale concurrent LLM serving.

title: ELI5 FlashAttention: Understanding GPU Architecture - Part 1
description: Learn the fundamentals of GPU memory hierarchy (HBM/SRAM), streaming multiprocessors, and how data moves inside a GPU during deep learning workloads.

title: ELI5 FlashAttention: Fast & Efficient Transformer Training - Part 2
description: Understand why standard self-attention is memory-bound (slow) and how FlashAttention makes it compute-bound (fast) by utilizing GPU SRAM tiles.

title: ELI5 FlashAttention Algorithm and Online Softmax - Part 3
description: A deep dive into the FlashAttention mathematical trick: computing softmax in blocks using the Online Normalizer algorithm without materializing the full N x N matrix.

title: Key Takeaways from LLaMA for Data Scientists
description: Core design decisions and architectural takeaways from the original LLaMA paper that data scientists and machine learning engineers can apply to their own work.

title: LLaMA 2 Explained: Pretraining, FineTuning, GQA, & Ghost Attention
description: A deep dive into the LLaMA 2 architecture, explaining pretraining details, fine-tuning processes, Grouped-Query Attention, and Ghost Attention mechanisms.

title: Calibration in Machine Learning Models
description: An explanation of model calibration and temperature scaling to ensure neural network confidence matches the actual probability of correctness.
